text:
max: Quick heads-up — GCP changed committed pricing for A100 in eu-west. Effective GPU-hour cost is up ~14% for our Dedicated pools. Need a rapid unit-econ sanity check.

olivia: Do we have the raw SKU diffs? Rough delta on $/GPU-hr or $/100k tokens?

max: Pulled billing export: A100-80GB reserved list moved 3.25 -> 3.71 EUR/hr. Net after discounts ~+14%. I pushed a small agg to BigQuery.

olivia: On our current Dedicated mix that maps to ~+$0.9 per 100k tokens for long prompt workloads. If we do nothing, margin drops ~8 percentage points on EU traffic.

sanjay: Cluster utilization is steady ~72%. If we tighten packing + reclaim idle pods we can claw back ~3-4% of GPU cost. Also looking at preemptible mix where possible.

rachel: For customers on committed blocks, pricing is fixed. For Hosted public endpoints we can change list rates. Need Sales/legal check on notice windows.

finance-bot: Forecast delta (quick): monthly run-rate +€420k for EU-hosted + Dedicated margin loss ~6pp. Quick table: ```Region | Delta/mo
EU | +€420k
US | +€0
Total | +€420k```

max: Proposals: 1) Absorb short-term + infra optim (Sanjay) 2) Regional hosted rate increase for EU endpoints (Rachel + Sales) 3) Accelerate committed-use renegotiation with GCP (Olivia). Prioritize 1+2.

sanjay: Starting aggressive packing tests now. Also checking whether we can shift some non-latency workloads out of eu-west to reduce EU reserved footprint. Egress/latency tradeoffs though.

rachel: If we announce regional rate changes, what's the lead time for enterprise customers? @olivia any legal flags?

olivia: Legal: hosted public rates can be updated immediately; committed/enterprise customers are typically grandfathered for contract term. I'll draft a short customer impact note.

max: Another option is a small "EU surcharge" add-on for new Dedicated deals to capture delta without reworking baseline SKUs. Thoughts?

sanjay: CI run: `./ops/pack-test --region eu-west --aggressive=true` — initial estimate 4-6% token cost improvement if safe.

deploy-bot: Pack-optimizer job started (job id: 5021). ETA ~2h.

rachel: Product needs a quick SKU blurb for Sales — 2 bullets + example quote. I can draft if someone gives the delta numbers.

max: Olivia, can you give a per-100k tokens delta and per-GPU-hr delta we can hand to Sales?

olivia: Preliminary: per-100k tokens delta: +$0.9 (hosted EU). Dedicated per-GPU-hr delta: +€0.46. I'll validate and post in #finance.

sanjay: If infra optim yields ~4% savings and Sales surcharges apply to new deals, we can keep margins within ~2pp of current. Not ideal but manageable short-term.

max: Owners: Sanjay (infra optim + packing), Olivia (pricing numbers + GCP renegotiation), Rachel (customer comms + hosted rate update). Target: updated model by EOD tomorrow.

rachel: I'll sync with Sales Ops and draft a comms plan. Need to know whether to grandfather new signups for X days.

olivia: I'll run sensitivity curves (-20% to +20% GPU price) and include commit-reprice scenarios for Exec. Uploading model to Drive now.

max: Also add regional unit-econ to the Console — we only have global split today and Sales needs region-level numbers. @deploy-bot can you open a ticket?

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-789: "Console - regional unit economics view" assigned to eng-platform. ETA 2w.

olivia: Final note: I'll start outreach to GCP account team to understand if there's any transitional pricing or supplemental credits.

max: OK. If no other blockers, we'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00 to review updated numbers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
